title: TOCTOU double-spend race in POST /checkout allows negative wallet balance
blast_radius: Any user can spend multiples of their wallet balance concurrently, driving balance negative (-60 on a 100 balance) and creating duplicate fulfilled orders.
trigger_likelihood: High: reproducible 100% of the time with just 2 simultaneous HTTP requests.
broken_invariant: Wallet balance must never become negative and total debited orders must never exceed initial balance under concurrent requests.
root_cause: POST /checkout reads store.getBalance(userId) before yielding the event loop at await delay(40), then re-reads and decrements balance without holding a per-user lock or enforcing a balance >= amount check inside an atomic critical section.

reproducer.observed_failure_output: Both concurrent POST /checkout ($80 each against $100 wallet) returned HTTP 200 OK; orders.length=2; final balance=-60.

disprover_notes: Checked server.js and store.js for any mutex, queue, or optimistic version check; none exists around /checkout.
minimal_fix: Wrap check-and-debit in a per-userId serialized mutex queue (see fixed-server.js:createKeyedMutex) or execute a single atomic conditional debit.
regression_test_strategy: Keep reproducers/double-spend.repro.test.cjs in CI asserting 1x 200 OK, 1x 409 Conflict, and balance == 20.

title: Non-idempotent POST /webhooks/payment double-credits user wallets on retries
blast_radius: Every webhook retry or concurrent redelivery from the payment processor permanently inflates user wallet balances.
trigger_likelihood: High: at-least-once delivery is standard across Stripe, PayPal, and queue brokers.
broken_invariant: Duplicate delivery of the same payment eventId must credit the target wallet at most once.
root_cause: POST /webhooks/payment never checks store.hasProcessedWebhook(eventId) or an in-flight deduplication set before awaiting and invoking store.recordWebhookCredit(eventId, userId, amount).

reproducer.observed_failure_output: Two deliveries of eventId evt_stripe_991 (amount=50) both returned 200 OK and credited wallet from 0 to 100.

disprover_notes: Confirmed store.hasProcessedWebhook exists at store.js:62-64 but is never called by server.js.
minimal_fix: Check both processed webhooks and an in-flight eventId Set synchronously before awaiting, and commit eventId alongside the balance credit atomically.
regression_test_strategy: Keep reproducers/webhook-duplicate.repro.test.cjs in CI asserting wallet balance == 50 and webhooks.length == 1.

title: Unbounded http.get in GET /recommendations hangs indefinitely when upstream stalls
blast_radius: Stalled upstream recommendation API leaks open sockets and holds handler promises forever, risking service-wide availability degradation.
trigger_likelihood: Medium-High during upstream network partitions or slow downstream tail latency.
broken_invariant: Outbound upstream HTTP calls must enforce an explicit timeout and return within bounded latency.
root_cause: GET /recommendations awaits a raw new Promise wrapping http.get(upstreamRecommendationsUrl) with no socket timeout option, no req.destroy() timer, and no AbortSignal.

reproducer.observed_failure_output: Against a local blackhole upstream TCP listener, GET /recommendations failed to respond before the 300ms client watchdog aborted with TimeoutError.

disprover_notes: Verified Node's http.get has no default short request timeout in this code path and no AbortSignal is passed.
minimal_fix: Use fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(upstreamTimeoutMs) }) and return a bounded 504 / empty fallback payload on timeout.
regression_test_strategy: Keep reproducers/timeout-hang.repro.test.cjs in CI against a local blackhole TCP socket.

title: Direct fs.writeFileSync in FileCheckoutStore.writeState risks JSON truncation on mid-write crash
broken_invariant: On-disk JSON state must remain valid and parseable if the process crashes mid-write.
root_cause: FileCheckoutStore.writeState calls fs.writeFileSync(this.filePath, ...) directly in place rather than writing a sibling temp file, calling fsyncSync, and atomically renaming.
unresolved_fact: Whether OS page-cache/power-loss truncation reproduces cleanly inside a pure userland Node test without syscall or block-device fault injection.
why_blocked: Standard Node process exit does not interrupt a synchronous kernel write(2) halfway through a small JSON buffer deterministically.
safe_verification_recipe: Run an isolated scratch container with dm-flakey or strace fault injection mid-write(2) and verify JSON.parse fails on recovery; compare against writeStateAtomic() at store.js:30-40.

title: Candidate duplicate refund race under concurrent POST /refund
disprover_evidence: Synchronous check of store.inFlightRefunds.has(orderId) || store.hasRefund(orderId) and immediate store.inFlightRefunds.add(orderId) happen on the same event-loop turn before await delay(30), with finally cleanup. Verified live in double-spend.repro.test.cjs: concurrent requests returned [200, 409] and refunds.length === 1.
rejection_reason: Single-threaded JS event loop makes the synchronous Set guard + cleanup in finally mutual-exclusive across concurrent requests in a single-process deployment.
